# Where to Watch Bad Counselors


by Angel | September 1, 2026


What do you get when two frat brothers with zero qualifications, 120 hours of community service, and a Christian summer camp collide? Apparently, a whole lot of chaos—and an unexpected lesson in grace.


*Bad Counselors* follows two party-loving college students who fake their way into summer camp to avoid expulsion, only to discover that pretending to be changed can be the first step toward actually changing.


[Watch Bad Counselors now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/bad-counselors)


### **The Worst Counselors Ever?**


Hungover, handcuffed, and facing expulsion, two frat brothers find themselves with a serious problem: They need to complete 120 hours of community service.


Their solution is less than conventional.


They pose as Christian camp counselors.


There’s just one small issue: Neither of them has any idea what they’re doing. They aren’t exactly familiar with Christian camp culture, and they’re certainly not the role models anyone expected to be leading a group of kids.


But keeping up the act means convincing everyone around them that they’re exactly who they claim to be.


### **When the Act Starts to Feel Real**


What begins as a scheme to get out of trouble quickly becomes more complicated.


As the two brothers spend time at camp, they form unexpected friendships, encounter people who see more in them than they see in themselves, and begin to experience the kind of community they never expected to find.


Slowly, the line between pretending and becoming starts to disappear.


The guys may have arrived at camp with the wrong intentions, but they soon discover that grace doesn’t require someone to have everything figured out first.


### **A Comedy With a Little More Heart**


Beneath the silly situations and classic camp antics, *Bad Counselors* is really a story about second chances.


The film explores what happens when people who seem completely out of place encounter faith, friendship, and a community willing to give them another shot. Their transformation isn’t instant or perfect, but that’s what makes the journey feel human.


One Guild member described the story as “a beautiful adaptation of the prodigal son,” while another called it a great story about how people can come to know Jesus “in the strangest ways.”


And sometimes, the strangest ways make for the funniest, most memorable stories.


### **Watch** ***Bad Counselors*** **on Angel**


If you’re looking for a lighthearted comedy with outrageous camp antics, unexpected friendships, and a story about grace and redemption, *Bad Counselors* is ready to turn your next movie night into a summer-camp adventure.


[Stream Bad Counselors today on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/bad-counselors)
